{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders only
df_compl = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df_compl[df_compl['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders in completed dataset: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Drop QA orders
df_clean = df_compl[df_compl['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
total_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Sort by revenue descending
total_revenue_by_channel = total_revenue_by_channel.sort_values(by='revenue', ascending=False)

# Print results
total_revenue_by_channel"}
